test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96289a61798b1889dcb7bdd41cb47585872e69145e7870cb355fce7e25762894.png]
solution:
The logic here is:

1) The number [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c65457a246b843e68f7c931a2e610a6968a43436a0df199660a2dfbe782136.png] is moving in the anticlockwise direction and at the corners only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/117e6f686d27c78e30bdbca31374f8f8b2438f6778b09cdc5029cf7854cf3d50.png] 

2) The sign [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/823df6f4f9b961c1fffa04c70f7912ffd08ebde534478cfe8dcaa446136368e2.png] is moving in an anticlockwise direction and it is in the middle of each line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c39d8b90d90191b32592928b180e0cbc0045f8eda935f44cc3c2c4125c195dc.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f83454d4b049ae4cadcf2158ddf9e1120d1df17746abbcaaa4a500c04cb9302.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 2**__'.
